pathAnonymization: Local workstation paths are anonymized with synthetic example-user identifiers; recorded evidence was not rerun.

checks.command: env -u MINDPLAYER_VERSION -u MINDPLAYER_TEST_REAL_JEV -u MINDPLAYER_TEST_BINARY cargo test --offline --locked --workspace -q -- --test-threads=2

assertions: one actual Jev judgment and native start per ordinary turn
selected model and effort equal both forwarded configuration fields
actual native rollout turn_context model and effort match each selection
actual native collaboration settings match each selection
actual terminal completion and bounded assistant output
same isolated thread, no tools, no automatic replay
temporary account state removed after owned child process-group exit
earlierAttempts: First integration attempt reached actual inference but an overly literal output assertion rejected OK followed by a period. The test now accepts only OK with optional terminal punctuation.

Second fresh isolated attempt failed before submission with a routed RPC rejection; the original test suppressed its reason. The test now includes only fixed safe failure codes. The cause of that attempt is unknown; no reliability claim is made.
The final fresh isolated attempt completed both ordinary turns. This does not establish Gateway behavior or eliminate the earlier failure.

rejectedImplementations.approach: Hold owned turn/steer until old turn completes, then translate it to turn/start
rejectedImplementations.reason: Native 0.162.1 awaits the steer RPC in its UI event loop. Holding it can block Escape and approvals and deadlock completion. Independent review also found cancellation, mixed-input ordering and inherited-settings defects.

rejectedImplementations.approach: Bind native Enter exclusively to queue
rejectedImplementations.reason: Five synthetic-backend actual-native-PTY tests establish ordinary queue behavior, but the native guard prevents idle !shell submission when submit is unbound. This is not a production-compatible fix.

rejectedImplementations.approach: Pretend a regular turn is non-steerable review or compact
rejectedImplementations.reason: The protocol only names review/compact kinds. Inventing such a backend state is false; rejected native steers can also merge separate prompts.

review.retainedTestsCodeReviewer: COMMENT; setup-cleanup and test-cancellation findings fixed and rechecked; no remaining findings in narrow recheck

simplifications: Removed the entire unsafe held-steer runtime prototype instead of layering compatibility workarounds over it.
Kept the existing input surface and runtime unchanged; no new controls, dependencies or automatic interrupts.
remaining: Busy Enter remains native same-turn steering and does not receive a fresh Jev model/effort selection.
Changing every busy prompt safely requires native UI semantic queue changes or an explicit input-behavior tradeoff; the current proxy alone is insufficient under the tested native client contract.
Actual native configuration records do not attest the provider's internal serving implementation or reasoning budget.
No new local installation or version bump has been claimed.
